The BLS 2025 median annual wage for sales managers is 148,270 U.S. dollars; 2025—2035 employment goes from 650,100 to 679,100, a change of 4.5%, with 47,300 annual openings. Chinese industry averages serve only as background.

Sales managers plan and direct the sale of products or services, assign territories, quotas, and targets, mentor sales teams, analyze sales and profitability records, handle customer complaints, and manage prices, budgets, and delivery collaboration within organizational authorization; personal sales performance does not equal team management capability.
